objective: Implement source-backed AdMob daily and month-to-date QMP 30% provisional sharing in authenticated user dashboards while preserving immutable last-month earnings, available/paid/reserved cash and release safety.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: read-only BUKLOD Connect live finance inspection 2026-11-18 Manila: policy user_pool_bps=3000, November 29 qualified contributors /3319 QMP, official noncash AdMob PHP 8.64 last observed Nov 9 local, no recorded sync invocation Nov 17, Finance V3 economics/settlement/withdrawals/payouts all false. GitHub main d23cd882f7d34c4bca3a110dadd04ee4cb2240a9 inspected; GitHub main is not necessarily the current Android production OTA source. No production provider credentials, payment balances, or OTA changed.
chosenApproach: Use official AdMob Network report DATE+APP with account default reporting timezone, atomic monotonic service-only preliminary month/day snapshots, and existing QMP-weighted member-only RPC. Add Today and withdrawal history to three existing user displays. Schedule opt-in hourly but do not activate without verified secrets.
selectionRationale: Reuse the existing 30% monthly Finance/QMP authority without multiplying preliminary estimates into cash, and expose changes after official provider computation without individual-ad money attribution.
alternativeApproaches: Convert QMP directly to PHP or ad-impression-based earning: rejected as unverified cash creation
Recalculate already finalized last-month shares on new QMP: rejected as historical corruption
Introduce an independent payout balance from preliminary reports: rejected as duplicate credit risk
preserveBehaviors: Native AdMob ads and fill, preload, dashboard transition and consent lifecycle remain unchanged
Immutable Finance V3 last-month settlement and cash-available/paid/reserved ledgers remain authoritative
No sponsor revenue participates in the 30% AdMob user pool
Current month QMP weight changes but Lifetime Points and monthly finalized history do not reset
No production OTA, new native module, or financial activation in the DEV PR
acceptanceChecks: Official report APP+DATE+PHP validation, footer and micros completeness confirmed with negative tests
Only service role writes source snapshots; authenticated readers see only their own QMP share
Latest month and provider day are matched in one atomic snapshot and stale reports fail closed
Today is included within This Month, never summed twice into Projected Overall
Last Month remains finalized only when Finance V3 actually settles; available, reserved and paid unchanged
30% pool is not withdrawable until reconciled and authorized financial close
Focused Node contracts plus SQL rolled-back compile/pass; full source and ad/nav regression CI before any release
Scheduler needs confirmed opt-in, endpoint, OAuth and runtime response before live status
No production OTA or database migration applied by this DEV candidate
R38 Economy CI must execute focused daily AdMob/QMP noncash, auth and monthly carryforward contracts plus Android staging JavaScript export without publishing an OTA.
